title: Regularize RenderEntity.VisualVariant contract + pin overtime-landing scoring (TASK-026 review residuals)
description: Residuals from the TASK-026 APUNTA review (rev-t026, MEDIUM-2c downgraded to LOW + one optional test pin). (1) ApuntaMicrogame encodes 0-255 aim-interpolation progress in RenderEntity.VisualVariant on PlayerAvatar entities — a semantic overload that is permissible under the field's 'mechanic-defined' wording but is undocumented on RenderEntity itself and in tension with GDD §10.4 prefab mapping (which reads VisualVariant as a prefab/skin selector). Decide and document the contract: either bless per-mechanic scalar-channel use of VisualVariant on RenderEntity's own doc comment (with the GDD §10.4 interaction spelled out), or move the interp progress to a dedicated field/channel. Must be resolved BEFORE any presenter consumes RenderState — sequence before or together with TASK-027 (StagePresenter). (2) Optional regression pin: a test asserting that the auto-fired shot landing during overtime still scores (the 'nobody loses their shot' GDD clause) — currently protected only indirectly.
acceptance_criteria: The VisualVariant contract decision is recorded: RenderEntity's doc comment states exactly what the field may carry (prefab/skin selector vs mechanic-defined scalar), and the GDD §10.4 prefab-mapping interaction is addressed either in the doc or by moving Apunta's interp progress to a dedicated channel
If the field semantics change, ApuntaMicrogame and its tests are updated and the fast suite stays green with no regression
A regression test pins that an auto-fired shot which lands during the overtime window still scores (GDD 'nobody loses their shot')
No presenter (TASK-027+) consumes RenderState before this contract is settled

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Delivered on master by dev-t101 (tests-after): 90e2a67 refactor(core) contract regularization -> 45c6259 test(core) AC3 regression pin. Suite 465 -> 466/466. Took the dedicated-channel path (orchestrator-recommended): NEW additive field RenderEntity.Progress01 (float [0,1], mechanic-defined, presentation-only — per-entity analog of HudState.Meters); VisualVariant doc comment tightened to the GDD 10.4 contract (discrete EntityKind+VisualVariant -> prefab/skin selector, small cardinality; Reacciona's Waiting/FalseStarted/Reacted codes named as the canonical legitimate example); future continuous values pointed at Progress01. ApuntaMicrogame PlayerAvatar now sets VisualVariant=0 + Progress01=interp; Target/Projectile explicitly zero Progress01 — RenderEntity array is a reused struct pool, every producer must set every field every tick or leak stale slot values; same zeroing applied to ReaccionaMicrogame PlayerAvatar defensively (doesn't use the field). Two existing 0..255-encoding assertions migrated to [0,1]. AC3 pin AutoFiredShot_LandingDuringOvertime_StillScores: rigged geometry (zero-span central zone pins target at center; fixed projectile speed) isolates overtime timing from charge-power precision; NON-VACUITY PROVEN: temporarily re-gating ResolveArrivals behind _tick < durationTicks (reverting TASK-026 HIGH-1 fix) makes the test fail as expected (AnyProjectileActive never false), reverted with zero git delta before staging. AC4 by inspection: no StagePresenter exists, nothing consumes RenderState. Constraint honored: nothing under Core/Runtime/Loop/ touched (surface = V2/{RenderEntity,ApuntaMicrogame,ReaccionaMicrogame} + ApuntaMicrogameV2Tests). Note: ReaccionaMicrogame touched (field-zeroing only) — TASK-025 is closed, no open review on that surface.
